incoherences.evidence: data_model rev 12 replaced CIQ_OP_Outcome with [Accepted, Withdrawn] (COH-08). Rounds.Rounds_Outcome is a Select with referredList CIQ_OP_Outcome (compiled: Field Rounds_Outcome, Model Rounds, ReferredList CIQ_OP_Outcome; list ListItems [Accepted, Withdrawn]). v4 L246/L251: on a Return the Workbench appends round n to Rounds with its outcome. A list-backed Select silently drops a value it does not hold (brd L1229).
incoherences.effect: Every returned round loses its 'Returned' outcome in the Rounds history. The point still progresses, but the round history (REQ-PROC-033/-035) is incomplete. A list binding on a published Process child column cannot be changed after generate.
incoherences.fix: Bind Rounds_Outcome to its own list, e.g. CIQ_Round_Outcome = Accepted, Returned, Withdrawn. Alternatively make it Text, machine-written by the Workbench (brd L1229 rule). Leave OP_Outcome on the two-value list. kf-architect then aligns architecture.lists CIQ_OP_Outcome (it still says Accepted, Returned, Withdrawn).

incoherences.evidence: v4 L250 lists Portal_Contact_Ids among the current-round fields that X3 copies. It is Editable only at OPNT_S0 and ReadOnly at OPNT_S1 and every OPNT_R_* step, where the Workbench writes round n+1.
incoherences.effect: If a Contact update changes the supplier contacts between rounds, round n+1's CIQP Query still goes to the old Assigned_Contacts.
incoherences.fix: Add Portal_Contact_Ids Editable at OPNT_R_* to security_handoff; kf-security-designer recompiles.

incoherences.evidence: The fallback store (Event_File, category 'Final PDF') exists only in data_model; no automations text names it. Z1 rest_completion item 1 is unchanged.
incoherences.effect: Whoever builds Z1/the renderer over REST has no instruction to write the PDF to a 'Final PDF' audit row when K-15 fails.
incoherences.fix: Extend Z1 rest_completion item 1: 'if K-15 fails, create a CIQ Audit Event row (Event_Category = "Final PDF", Case_Item_Id, Object_Item_Id) with the PDF in Event_File and its hash'. Make K-15 an acceptance test.

incoherences.evidence: Markets_Label (X1 portal header label) is Editable only at CASE_S0; D23 left it out.
incoherences.effect: After an accepted market correction, the case's Markets_Label stays stale. The portal copy would not update anyway, because X1 fires once.
incoherences.fix: Optional: Markets_Label Editable at CASE_S5 and CASE_S8 with Target_Markets_Text.

ratchet: RAT-1 ROLE_ACCESS_COLLAPSE: don't flag roles whose workflow assignee_role steps are disjoint.
RAT-2 never-writable field: warn on a non-formula Process field that is ReadOnly at every step and has no declared post-End writer.
RAT-3 stale hold: warn when a step condition reads fields whose last writable step is before an intervening parallel block.
RAT-4 handoff input: a field mapped into a required target field must be Mandatory or gate-checked at the step whose entry fires the handoff.

RAT-5 shared list: when a list's items change, list every field (header and child-table column) whose referredList is that list; flag one that is documented or scenario-written with a value the list no longer holds (would catch COH-11).
RAT-6 doc drift: warn when free text in workflow/security/automations names a field id that no longer exists in data_model (would catch RR-5 Open_Items_Gate).
content.verdict_note: Every in-scope journey (j01-j20) is end-to-end satisfiable at rev 18, and 30/30 scenarios replay. COH-01, -02, -03, -04, -05, -07, -08 and -10 are closed; COH-06 and COH-09 are closed except minor residuals. One regression must be fixed before generate: COH-11, a one-field data_model change that cannot be made after publish. COH-12, COH-09r and COH-06r are bounded minor repairs. R-02 and COH-04 wait on Thomas (Q8, D23).
